office_does: The sheriff runs county law enforcement, the jail, and search and rescue; four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Sheriff Summer Scheyer, who won the office by 25 votes in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Skamania County Sheriff in her fourth year in office and a law enforcement officer for 22 years, nearly 20 in the county; running as a Republican.
highlights: Says lost federal Secure Rural Schools money cost two patrol deputies in 2025 [S4]
Her 2024 sales tax for an animal control officer failed, 3,750 to 3,297 [S5][S6]
Proposed bringing volunteer teams under sheriff's office oversight [S7]
